title: Scales of Justice
summary: Recover the koi master's stolen gift after a drake ambush.
overview: Recover the koi master's stolen gift after a drake ambush.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Track the usurper's escape instead of assuming the encounter is finished at 75%.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The mission handoff spawns a drake usurper and two conspirators attacking the koi master.
At 75% health, the usurper casts its escape effects, teleports to a random listed position and clears hate.
Find the escaped usurper and return the recovered quest object to the koi master.

notes: Approval E319. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
